newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Information in $245.6 mln deal with Nextwave.
newsitem.headline: Korea Information in $245.6 mln deal with Nextwave.

text.p: Korea Information and Communications Co said on Tuesday it had been chosen as the main contractor for U.S.-based Nextwave Telecommunications Inc's consumer service and billing system project.
The deal is valued at $245.6 million in software and hardware over the next five years.
Korea Information will form a consortium to provide the San Diego firm with software and hardware for customer service, billing and network management systems, the company said in a statement.
It said Korea Information's business with the U.S. firm was expected to exceed $960 million by 2006 and it was almost sure to participate in Nextwave's future expansion projects.
The statement said eight South Korean companies, including Pohang Iron and Steel Co and Korea Electric Power Corp, had stakes in Nextwave.
